subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw accept wrapping matrix-js-sdk's private Rust crypto to-device preprocessor for this Matrix SAS compatibility bug after live proof is added?
rationale: The code location appears correct for the observed dependency flow, but the permanent compatibility cost of a private SDK hook and the E2EE verification boundary need maintainer ownership before merge.

options.title: Require proof, then accept the hook
options.body: Ask for redacted live Matrix/Element verification proof from this branch, then merge if maintainers accept the private preprocessor hook as a narrow compatibility workaround.

options.title: Proof override with explicit ownership
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly override the missing proof gate and own the matrix-js-sdk private-hook risk if the issue evidence is sufficient for this release.

options.title: Pause for upstream path
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers do not want OpenClaw to patch the private Rust crypto preprocessor boundary.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept the hook
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live Matrix/Element verification proof from this branch, then merge if maintainers accept the private preprocessor hook as a narrow compatibility workaround.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest feature-history signal for Matrix E2EE and verification ownership points to gumadeiras.
